verdict.rationale: React Compiler is documented as a build-time optimizer that removes the need for manual memoization (useMemo, useCallback, React.memo). Nothing in the evidence says it removes a virtual DOM diffing step. Community discussion instead describes React keeping its own DOM abstraction with change management, so the compiler is an adjacent optimization rather than diff-free DOM updates. Rendering strategy is a fair axis for a UI framework, so this is an applicable-but-unmet story.
